summary: dellemc.openmanage OME, OME Modular and OMEVV modules are compatible with ansible-core 2.19, and more iDRAC modules and roles (certificates, SCP, license, OS deployment, storage, redfish firmware) support iDRAC10.
questions: Are OpenManage Enterprise modules compatible with ansible-core 2.19?
Which openmanage roles support iDRAC10 in Ansible 13?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage 13.0.0 changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- OpenManage Enterprise, OME Modular and OME Integration for VMware vCenter modules are compatible with **ansible-core 2.19**.
- iDRAC10 support added to: `idrac_certificate`, `idrac_export_server_config_profile`, `idrac_firmware`, `idrac_import_server_config_profile`, `idrac_os_deployment`, `idrac_storage_controller` and `redfish_firmware` roles; and `idrac_license`, `idrac_os_deployment`, `idrac_redfish_storage_controller`, `idrac_server_config_profile`, `idrac_storage_volume`, `redfish_firmware_rollback`, `redfish_storage_volume` modules (plus the `redfish_storage_volume` role).
